nodes.label: Redbook-rip App Icon (icon.svg)
nodes.rationale: App branding for the redbook-rip crate: the name references the 'Red Book' CD-DA (Compact Disc Digital Audio) standard, visualized as a literal red book cover with an embedded compact disc and music note, signaling that the project extracts audio CDs.

nodes.label: Red Book/Album Cover Motif
nodes.source_location: cover path: M116 40 H60 Q40 40 40 60 V196 Q40 216 60 216 H216 V140 Z, fill url(#cover)
nodes.rationale: The cover uses a deep red gradient (#e0343c to #a3141d) with dark spine shadow lines near the left edge, reading as both a hardcover book (the 'red book' pun) and a CD album case; the square bottom-right corner anchors it to the page strip.

nodes.label: Compact Disc (Disc with Rainbow Sheen)
nodes.source_location: circles at cx=212 cy=52, fills url(#disc) and url(#sheen)
nodes.rationale: The disc is drawn with concentric guide rings, a hub hole matching the dark background color, and an iridescent linear-gradient sheen (blue-purple-pink-mint) to evoke a real polycarbonate CD surface, placing it behind and through the cut in the cover.

nodes.label: Diagonal Cut Composition
nodes.rationale: The cover's top-right corner is sliced off diagonally so the CD shows through the cut, a design decision that fuses the book and disc motifs into one silhouette and visually communicates 'extracting the disc from the album/book'.

nodes.label: Embossed Music Note
nodes.source_location: g transform=translate(76 108) scale(1.9), two-ellipse beamed note
nodes.rationale: A beamed double eighth note is embossed in the icon's dark background color (#12151b, 0.85 opacity) on the red cover, stating that the project is about music/audio content rather than data CDs.
